title.narrative: Strengthen collaboration for TB/HIV Integration services for KPs and vulnerable groups - Guyana (01-Jan-2022-31-Dec-2024)

description.narrative: Guyana, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Co-operative Republic of Guyana (MOH)This program has the following goals: Improve case detection of RR-TB/MDR-TB to at least 85% by 2024. Reduce TB/HIV related mortality to under 1 per 100,000 by 2024. By 2025, reduce HIV-related stigma and discrimination.. By 2025, reduce the number of incidences of HIV-related stigma and discrimination experienced by PLHIV and Key populations. By 2025, reduce new HIV infections among key populations and other vulnerable groups by 95%. By 2025, reduce AIDS-related deaths by 95% and have equal quality of life and longevity with the rest of the population. The objectives of this program are: Increase case detection of RR-TB/MDR-TB to over 85% by 2024. Increase TB treatment success for RR-TB/MDR-TB to over 70 % by 2024. Increase ART coverage among TB/HIV patients to over 95% by 2024. Increase IPT among PLHIV with TB to over 95 % by 2024. To reduce HIV associated mortality. To increase the mean survival time of persons with AIDS. To reduce the HIV seroprevalence among female sex workers. To reduce the HIV seroprevalence among men who have sex with men
